NVIDIA CUDA Tile (cuTile) is a Python-based DSL and parallel programming model for NVIDIA GPUs that automatically leverages advanced hardware capabilities to deliver peak performance for tile-level GPU programming. By abstracting thread- and warp-level scheduling behind high-level, tile-centric primitives, cuTile enables you to write GPU kernels in Python while compiler optimizations automatically…
